My own gap code on remeasure/inband_pick3/claim_O7nominal_unpriced_{bench,held}_perpose.json gives 18.32 / 23.54, against the leader's 18.48 / 23.45 (remeasure/slipper-nose-knuckle-3r_*_perpose.json). My own paired bootstrap (4000 draws, seed 1, poses resampled within kind) puts the unpriced pick3 against the leader at bench -0.17, 90 % CI [-1.95, +1.72], and held +0.08, CI [-0.83, +1.31], P(pick3 better) 0.38. The held-out claim of 22.86 does not hold under the incumbent's reading.

Confirmed. docs/dashboard/data/morphs.json (05a8b1f) shows inband-rssr-knuckle-3r with v_gap 18.33 while its status is 'screened'. Sorted by v_gap it ranks first, above minarc-stop-knuckle-4r 18.40, slipper-nose-knuckle-3r 18.49 and trimlug-k165-knuckle-3r 18.51. Its v_reach, v_follow, v_inband14 and v_contact are null. The same card's verdict text still says 'at PARITY with slipper-nose, not ahead'. The paired edge is noise (my bootstrap: priced held -0.59, CI [-1.60, +0.32]).

Measured, and below every documented threshold, with no effect on the claim. The polish did not grow the ear: density.ear.n is 44 in fit_base.json and fit_O9.json, and 30 de-duplicated. The de-dup moves in-band by 0.0014-0.0016, i.e. 0.15 points: fit 0.9063 -> 0.9048 (fit_base / fit_dedup), and priced held 0.9056 -> 0.9041. I recomputed this from farm/claim_pick3_fit60_held_perpose.json vs remeasure/inband_pick3/claim_O9rh15.9_dedup_held_perpose.json. The documented part-weighting threshold is TH part_weight_watch 3.0 points (tools/alignment_audit.py line 62; ALIGNMENT.md section 5), 20x larger. The tool's own sampling check on this row reads ok, with sample-weighted 0.897 vs part-weighted 0.912 (-1.54 points). Overall the sampling penalises this design (docs/alignment/inband-rssr-knuckle-3r.json checks.sampling). The claimed gap is unchanged at 18.33 / 22.86 de-duplicated (claim_O9rh15.9_dedup_{bench,held}: 18.33 / 22.87 recomputed). The one reading it moves, unpriced held 23.54 -> 23.62, does not change the leader decision, which already fails at 23.54. The auditor itself finds pick3's +0.0100 gain is not the ear. This is a model sampling artefact with no wearer cost and no score gain on the claim.

The counts are confirmed, but they are near-touch readings, and the documented rule makes those report-only. Recounted from the per-pose dumps (min_mm < 1 on taken poses): O9 priced 6 / 25 vs the leader's 2 / 14; counting the model's extra walls (cmin), 7 / 25 vs 3 / 14. Under 2 mm it is 23 / 58 vs 25 / 62 (with cmin 31 / 70 vs 30 / 67). docs/ALIGNMENT.md section 6, entry 2026-10-17.2, says 'near_touch is report-only (numbers kept, level always ok)', and tools/alignment_audit.py c_near_touch line 277 has lvl = 'ok'. CLAUDE.md user decisions (3) and (6) say 'the 1 mm / 2 mm near-touch readings are reported only' and that the plain gap counts contact as penetration. On the scored contact the O9 build is shallower than the leader: bench 1 pose / 0.22 mm vs 2 / 14.75 mm, held 8 / 21.16 mm vs 10 / 46.12 mm (the same dumps). The near-touch shift comes from the O9 head, which M2 already covers. The counts stay in the report, with no level.
